g.text: PROVENANCE & VERSION CONTROL LOOP: MAGIT + CHANNELS-LOCK.SCM + SELF-REFERENTIAL SYSTEM

svg.text: 1. Edit system.org → 2. Test in Geiser (C-c C-c) → 3. Auto-Tangle on Save (C-c C-v t) → 4. Pin (guix describe -f channels > channels-lock.scm) → 5. Commit in Magit (C-x g)
Result: Any workstation, VM, or server can clone your repo and run guix time-machine -C channels-lock.scm -- system reconfigure config.scm for an identical system!
